query history retained locally for quick reuse

major_next_improvements.item: Bundle PDF.js and OCR engine locally
major_next_improvements.why: New PDF/image document extraction should work fully offline; current core search is offline but first-use OCR/PDF parsing can require internet.
Uploaded documents should be parsed, classified, deduplicated, dated and promoted into the searchable KB only after review.
Every material sentence should point to the exact saved document/page/section instead of only a source label.
